# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.9 Worker 2: 4 Colonial Charter Goals & Frontier Pacing 2.0 (oe_col2_). Generated by gen_v99_colonization.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Dispatch Frontier Surveyor & Quartermaster
# Overcomes ecological supply/climate friction and accelerates frontier logistics.
oe_col2_frontier_surveyor = {
	ability = adm
	helps_with = "charter|location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		num_locations > 0
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			has_colonial_charters = yes
			has_ports = yes
			num_locations >= 5
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_col2_surveyor_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_col2_surveyor_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	on_activate = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col2_surveyor_logistics_mod
				years = 5
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		colonial_migration_size_modifier = 0.15
		colonial_range_modifier = 0.15
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_supply_limit_modifier = 0.25
		local_migration_attraction = 0.35
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}
}

# 2. Charter Overseas Trading Company
# Upgrades coastal outposts into maritime trade hubs and reinforces v9.0 Far Seas Plan A dividends.
oe_col2_charter_trading_house = {
	ability = dip
	helps_with = "charter|location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		has_ports = yes
	}

	allow = {
		has_ports = yes
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_col2_trading_house_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_col2_trading_house_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
				is_coastal = yes
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	on_activate = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					oe_far_roman_host = yes
					OR = {
						oe_far_east_open = yes
						oe_far_west_open = yes
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_col2_charter_company_dividend_mod
					years = 5
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		trade_range_modifier = 0.10
		trade_sea_efficiency = 0.05
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_maritime_presence = 0.12
		local_trade_center_power = 0.10
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}
}

# 3. Mediate Frontier & Native Disputes
# Pacifies frontier unrest, safeguards native coexistence, and lifts raw material extraction.
oe_col2_mediate_frontier_disputes = {
	ability = dip
	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations > 0
	}

	allow = {
		num_locations >= 3
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_col2_mediate_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_col2_mediate_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	country_modifier = {
		tolerance_heathen = 0.5
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_unrest = -0.05
		local_raw_material_output = 0.10
		local_monthly_prosperity = 0.002
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}
}
